no_data.title: Linz Netz: no consumption values yet
no_data.description: The Serviceportal has no consumption values yet. After registering, the first values arrive the next day from about noon at the earliest. The integration imports them automatically; this notice disappears after the next successful fetch with values.

daily_only.title: Linz Netz delivers daily values only
daily_only.description: Quarter-hour values are not enabled in the Serviceportal yet. Until then the integration imports daily values: each day's consumption appears in the first hour of that day in the Energy dashboard. For hourly values, give consent under "Viertelstundenwerte aktivieren" in the portal; enabling usually takes up to two working days. The integration then switches automatically and this notice disappears.
